name: redstone-removal
comment: Removal and drop paths of the redstone blocks, on the stone platform at y = 60; a player at (0.5, 61, 10.5) only for use_item. Row z = 0: a torch at x = -8 and wire x = -7..0; at t = 5 the wire at x = -4 is removed by set_block 0 (BlockRedstoneWire.onBlockRemoval propagates at the now-air cell, which still holds the old level). Row z = 2: a torch at x = -8, wire x = -7..-3, a repeater (93, meta 1: input -x, output +x) at x = -2 and wire x = -1..0; at t = 8 the platform block under the powered repeater is removed (BlockRedstoneRepeater.onNeighborBlockChange: canBlockStay false, dropBlockAsItem, setBlockWithNotify 0), at t = 11 the one under the wire at x = -5 (BlockRedstoneWire.onNeighborBlockChange drop path). Buttons (77, meta 1) on stone blocks at x = -2: (-1, 61, 5) pressed at t = 1 and removed by set_block 0 at t = 3 (BlockButton.onBlockRemoval while pressed; its 20-tick update later finds air), (-1, 61, 7) pressed at t = 1 and its stone removed at t = 4 (BlockButton.onNeighborBlockChange drop path, then onBlockRemoval while pressed). A floor lever (69, meta 5) at (2, 61, 5) switched on at t = 1, the platform block under it removed at t = 6 (BlockLever.onNeighborBlockChange drop path, onBlockRemoval while on). Wire beside each button and the lever. Wooden plates (72) at (0, 61, -4) and (4, 61, -4) with an item falling onto each (pressed at t = 8): the first removed by set_block 0 at t = 15 (BlockPressurePlate.onBlockRemoval while pressed), the platform block under the second removed at t = 16 (onNeighborBlockChange drop path; the item falls through). Dumps: block_box over all rows, power beside each source, scheduled_ticks, the items (ids 1-7; the dropped ones draw World.rand; the player, whose own update is Phase 2, is left out), rng_state.
